content.rendered:
OPEN HOUSE AT SHERWOOD MIDDLE SCHOOL 

All grades are welcome to attend any of the following dates: 

Aug. 17: 10:00 am – 2:00 pm 

Aug. 18: 10:00 am – 2:00 pm

Aug. 22: 10:00 am – 2:00 pm, and 4:00 pm – 7:00 pm

Open House provides an opportunity for students and/or parents to pick up student schedules if needed, locate classrooms, and practice opening lockers. All students will have a locker assigned to them however the use of lockers is optional. 

Entry for Open House will be through the Activities Entrance on the east side of the building. Stations will be arranged in the commons to pick up printed schedules and drop off donated supplies. No elective class fee payments are required this year. 

STUDENT SCHEDULES

Student Schedules will be viewable after 8:30 am, on August 16, 2023 via StudentVUE and/or ParentVUE. Locker assignments will also be available and can be found in the Student Information tab at the bottom of the page under “Student Locker”. If you are having trouble accessing ParentVUE and/or StudentVUE please reach out to the school. SCHEDULES ARE NOT FINAL UNTIL THE FIRST DAY OF SCHOOL. 

Up until classes begin, small movement within the Master Schedule may result in student schedule changes. Please make sure you continue to check Student/ParentVUE until school starts. Unless a student has an incomplete schedule, has been placed in the wrong Math class, or a schedule shows incorrect information, requests for schedule changes will not be granted.
